title: Morning Brief — Saturday, 10 October 2026
description: A spike in trading-card thefts prompting shops to tighten security and the ATO pressing ahead with its credit card payment ban, Queensland's latest Residential Activation Fund round for Toowoomba and the Lockyer Valley, plus the final days of HOTA's White Rabbit Collection exhibition on the Gold Coast. 한국어로도 브리핑을 전해드립니다.

show.channel_description: A short daily news brief covering Australian national news, Queensland, and the Gold Coast — made to listen to on the morning drive.
